steps.title: Initialize PriyaAi Girlfriend Project
steps.description: Define basic project configuration parameters including target SDK version 34 and dynamic application package name com.priyaaigirlfriend.app.

steps.title: Configure build.gradle Requirements
steps.description: Set up the Android app build parameters targeting Android 14 (API level 34) and using Gradle 8.5 compatible structures.

steps.title: Update AndroidManifest.xml Configuration
steps.description: Declare Internet access permission and specify PriyaAi Girlfriend's main activity as the startup launcher class with appropriate application tags.

steps.title: Build activity_main.xml Layout File
steps.description: Design user interface components including a top-level customized action header, settings trigger, scrolling dialogue screen container, and message composer layout.

steps.title: Establish Chat Message Data Contract
steps.description: Implement the core chat message properties, structure user or response flags, and organize standard message text configurations.

steps.title: Program Dynamic Gradient Bubbles and Layout Elements
steps.description: Use programmatic Android Drawables to construct rounded bubble shapes with dynamically changing color codes to separate model and human dialogs.

steps.title: Integrate SharedPreferences Storage System
steps.description: Build logic for locally loading and editing settings parameters such as current API authorizations and system response rules.

steps.title: Build custom Settings Dialog View Component
steps.description: Develop an input interface for updating user preferences and overriding default Gemini 1.5 system instructions dynamically.

steps.title: Structure Gemini HTTP Rest Request Headers
steps.description: Write JSON formatting models to structure previous conversation records and customize user system prompts into the standard API body requests.

steps.title: Implement Asynchronous Gemini Response Worker Process
steps.description: Perform background network execution threads to execute REST queries to the Gemini endpoints and securely process output response packages.

steps.title: Setup Default AI Companion Dialogue Configuration
steps.description: Prepopulate conversational lists with warm welcoming interactions from Priya on startup to ensure a charming initial app state.

steps.title: Building PriyaAi Girlfriend
steps.description: Run build parameters to compile all resource attributes and execute Java sources in a standard debug framework environment.
